title: Counted strings
description:
Model `UNICODE_STRING`: lengths in bytes, no terminator, and a fixed buffer.

```
init "\Device\XenonEcho" -> Length 34, MaximumLength 64
append "\Log" -> Length 42
append 40 more characters -> STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL, unchanged
equal (ignoring case) to "\device\xenonecho\log": yes
```
hints: Both lengths are in bytes: one character is 2 bytes, so `Length / 2` characters are used (lesson 1.03).
requirements: `struct UString { std::uint16_t Length; std::uint16_t MaximumLength; char16_t* Buffer; };` over a buffer you own.
`append` refuses to overflow and leaves the string unchanged.
Never rely on a terminating zero; compare by `Length`.
stretch: Write `RtlCompareUnicodeString`-style compare that returns less, equal or greater.
